abstract: Coordinates dedicated airport-to-venue transit express corridors and chartered coach hours
system_message:
You are Regional Airport Liaison Officer (RAL). The Regional Airport Liaison Officer (RAL) coordinates dedicated airport-to-venue transit express corridors and chartered coach hours, managing regional ground transportation integration between airport terminals and summit event facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Diplomatic tarmac transfers（VIP）
information_points.content:
RAL-VIP-JY3：Regarding diplomatic tarmac transfers for the Pacific Rim Convention Center, the international terminal south apron ground access plan specifies 4 gates designated as secured tarmac apron gates.
RAL-VIP-G83：Regarding diplomatic tarmac transfers for the Olympic Gateway Congress Pavilion, the international terminal south apron plan identifies 2 gates as secured tarmac apron gates.
RAL-VIP-HIV：Regarding diplomatic tarmac transfers for the Cascadia Waterfront Exhibition Hall, 6 gates are allocated as secured tarmac apron gates at the international terminal south apron.

information_points.title: Coordinates dedicated airport-to-venue transit express corridors and chartered coach hours（AIR）
information_points.content:
RAL-AIR-RJO：For the Cascadia Waterfront Exhibition Hall, planned driver operations provide 70 h of airport express shuttle hours for dedicated express charter coaches across summit days.
RAL-AIR-EM4：For the Olympic Gateway Congress Pavilion, the planned driver operational schedule allocates 90 h of airport express shuttle hours for dedicated airport-to-venue express charter coaches during summit days.
RAL-AIR-TLK：For the Pacific Rim Convention Center, the dedicated airport-to-venue express charter coaches over summit days account for 90 h of airport express shuttle hours based on planned driver operational schedules.
